Reserve dependency elements for unavoidable external inheritance

Dependency types exist for the narrow case where an external library requires the application to inherit or implement a type it cannot control. These diagnostics prevent internally complex code from being relabelled as a dependency to escape normal service rules.

The value of enforcing this family

External constraints stay isolated and only brokers are allowed to consume the resulting adapter.

Choose a diagnostic below for its Standard references, architectural rationale and practical bad and good code examples.
